rules.startup: Process launch to observable protocol/service milestones; never counted as query latency.
rules.initialize: LSP initialize request send to initialize response receive, followed by initialized notification.
rules.workspace_ready: Server-specific normal service-ready boundary. Target operations must not run to establish readiness.
rules.document_admission: Open/change notifications through an explicit server-observed current-document boundary. Any diagnostics used as the boundary are recorded as preparation.
rules.first_use: First request of the measured operation/target after documented preparation. No operation-specific warmup may precede it.
rules.warmup: Symmetric operation-specific requests whose rows are retained but excluded from steady statistics.
rules.steady: Measured operation samples after the configured warmup count; only correct samples contribute to latency percentiles.
